item.title: Canadian passport fees are going up this month — Here's how much more you'll pay
item.description: If you've been putting off renewing your passport, now might be the time to get moving.According to a federal government announcement, Canada is changing how it calculates citizens' passport fees, and the new prices kick in on March 31, 2026.
